subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Consolidation 4: Story and English in action
outcomes: I can put the story "The robot" in order and retell it.
I can pay a compliment and say thank you.
I can remember the value: Do exercise.

tf.s: At the start of "The robot", the children open a box with robot parts.
tf.why: The story starts with a box.

tf.s: Gymbot's first instruction is "Stand up, please!"
The value of "The robot" is "Eat sweets."
"What a cool kite!" is a compliment.
We answer a compliment with "Thank you."
In the story, the children put the robot together.
"Bend your knees and touch your toes!" is in the story.
A good reply to "What a cool toy!" is "No, thank you, go away."
In the story, Gymbot tells the children to sit and watch TV.
To retell a story, we say what happens in order.

boxes.q: You like a kite. You say:
What a cool toy! You answer:
Move your legs and stamp your ___!
Bend your knees and touch your ___!
Look at my ___. – What a cool costume!

mcq.q: Who gives the exercise instructions in the story?
Which line is from the story?
o: Bend your knees and touch your toes!
mcq.why: Gymbot says this in the story.

mcq.q: What do we say after a compliment?
Which value does the story teach?
Your friend shows you a new toy. Pay a compliment.
Retell the first frame of "The robot".
o: The children open a box with robot parts.
mcq.why: The story starts with the box.

mcq.q: Complete: Look at my picture. – What a cool ___! – Thank you.
mcq.why: The compliment is about the picture.

mcq.q: Which is the right order in "The robot"?
o: open the box, put it together, Stand up please!
Stand up please!, open the box, put it together
put it together, Stand up please!, open the box
Stand up please!, put it together, open the box
mcq.why: First the box, then they build it, then Gymbot speaks.

mcq.q: Why do the children put the robot together?
o: Because the parts are in a box.
What a cool kite! – Thank you.
Give me the kite! – Thank you.
mcq.why: A kind compliment and a polite reply.
